subject: Quarter Handback: Ownership Slate & Exec Signups
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quarter Handback: Ownership Slate & Exec Signups

Team —

Attached is the Q3 Ownership Slate (v3) and the QBR runbook draft. This is the handback from product & strategy after the leadership calibration session last week. Key asks:

- Owners: please confirm "ACCEPT" or "DELEGATE" for each objective row assigned to you by EOD Tuesday (2027-06-29). If you delegate, include the new owner and a 1-line reason.
- Exec slots: we have three 12-minute executive slots during the QBR; sign up for a slot if your objective requires a live readout.
- Metrics: call out any targets that need revision with a short justification; we can still adjust before publish.

Quick context: we tightened success metrics on Core Inference Cost (-18% tokens/unit) and added a performance SLO for dedicated pools. The slate highlights the fallback policy work that ties to reliability.

Next steps:
- I will consolidate responses and publish the executive slate on Thursday (2027-07-01).
- If you need a quick alignment, block 30 minutes on my calendar — I can do 2027-06-28 afternoon.

Attachments: Q3_Ownership_Slate_v3.xlsx, QBR_Runbook_2027_v1.docx

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-27T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Handback: Ownership Slate & Exec Signups

Michael —

ACCEPT on the Reliability objective (row 12). I propose a small tweak to the SLO target: move 99.7% -> 99.8% for dedicated pools given recent infra telemetry. Rationale: sustained improvements from kernel upgrades justify tightening the bar. If leadership prefers to keep 99.7% for safety, I can accept as-is.

Also flagged an owners column typo on row 9 — I attached a 1-line change in the updated sheet.

Kimberly Park
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Q3_Ownership_Slate_v3_kp_note.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-27T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Handback: Ownership Slate & Exec Signups

Quick question re: Capacity Optimization objective (row 5). We currently have two engineering owners across runtime and infra. Given hiring cadence, can we move the quantization work stream to Platform (Kim) and keep runtime focused on batching+routing? That reduces cross-team dependencies. If yes, I will update the owner rows and adjust the milestone timeline.

Also: can someone confirm the budget ask in row 7 — I want to ensure procurement and finance are looped before publish.

Karthik
Director, Serving Runtime

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Handback: Ownership Slate & Exec Signups

Thanks Karthik —

Kim, fine to take quantization under Platform; Karthik, please update the slate to show Kim as owner for the quantization stream and shift the platform milestone dates by two weeks to reflect realistic handoff.

Marissa — can you confirm the budget ask (row 7) with finance and drop a note in the sheet? If finance needs procurement signoff, flag that as a blocker.

I booked a 30-minute fallback slot on 2027-06-28 at 15:00 PT for any quick alignment (invite sent). I will plan to publish the consolidated slate on 2027-07-01 morning.

Michael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-29T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Handback: Ownership Slate & Exec Signups

Confirmed — finance has visibility and the budget ask in row 7 is approved at a headcount-neutral reallocation. No procurement gating expected for the planned Q3 experiments. Updated the sheet with a finance comment and added the HS-73492 cross-ref.

I ACCEPT the Growth objective (row 3) and will take the exec slot if leadership wants a live demo of the usage analytics.

Marissa Cole
Growth Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Claudia Ramos <claudia@stratos-consulting.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Handback: Ownership Slate & Exec Signups / QBR facilitation availability

Hi Michael & team —

Thanks for sharing the slate. I can facilitate the QBR on 2027-07-14; I have three facilitation windows that day and can reserve the morning block if you want continuity across exec slots. If you prefer to keep exec presenters in control, I can simply run the room and capture follow-ups.

Available: 09:00-11:30 PT (recommended) or 13:30-15:00 PT. Let me know which you prefer and I will put a calendar hold.

Claudia Ramos
Principal, Stratos Consulting
